final: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN CAST(t.amount AS REAL) WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -CAST(t.amount AS REAL) END) as avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as trans_count FROM trans t LEFT JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06' AND d.A3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as overall_average FROM regional_stats WHERE avg_signed_amount IS NOT NULL) SELECT region, avg_signed_amount, trans_count, avg_signed_amount / (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as ratio FROM regional_stats WHERE avg_signed_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region
